biotools.summary: COLMARppm is a web server tool for the accurate and rapid prediction of 1H and 13C NMR chemical shifts of organic molecules and metabolites. It utilizes an empirical prediction strategy to provide predicted chemical shifts for candidate structures and can be directly incorporated into metabolomics workflows.
